title: Never hardcode: every path, name, host, port, label, threshold and route comes from config or a template token, validated by schema
text: Owner, 2026-10-11 18:35Z: 'NEVER HARDCODE, we're fucked then.' Binding: a literal that could differ in another repo, host or run is a defect; config files with schemas and ${repo} style tokens carry it; lint fails a hardcoded absolute path or host in a script.
